title: The Greek gods.
lede: The fourteen who matter most, what each of them looked after, and the symbols that give them away. Browse, hide half, then let the quiz find out what stuck.

card.title: Greek gods
card.desc: Fourteen gods of Olympus and below: their areas and their symbols.

items.name: Zeus
items.domain: King of the gods; sky and thunder
items.hook: Ruled from the top of Mount Olympus and settled arguments by throwing lightning at them.

items.name: Poseidon
items.hook: Called the Earth-shaker: when the ground trembles, he's stamping about somewhere.

items.name: Hades
items.hook: The three brothers drew lots for the world. Zeus got the sky, Poseidon the sea, and Hades the basement.

items.name: Hera
items.domain: Queen of the gods; marriage and family
items.hook: Goddess of marriage, married to Zeus. You can imagine how that went.

items.name: Demeter
items.domain: The harvest, grain and fertile earth
items.hook: While her daughter Persephone is down in the underworld, she grieves and nothing grows. Hence winter.

items.name: Hephaestus
items.hook: Thrown off Olympus and left lame, then built the gods' palaces and Achilles' armour regardless.

items.name: Ares
items.hook: The brawling side of war. Athena got the strategy; he got the shouting.

items.name: Apollo
items.hook: Spoke through the Oracle at Delphi, and never once gave a straight answer.

items.name: Artemis
items.domain: The hunt, the moon and wild things
items.hook: Apollo's twin, and patron of anyone who'd rather be in a forest than at a party.

items.name: Aphrodite
items.hook: Rose from the sea foam and came ashore on a scallop shell. Botticelli painted the moment.

items.name: Hermes
items.hook: Stole Apollo's cattle on the day he was born, then talked his way out of it with a lyre he'd just invented.

items.name: Dionysus
items.hook: Greek theatre grew out of his festivals, so every play is technically a party in his honour.

items.name: Athena
items.hook: Sprang fully armoured from Zeus's head, gave Athens the olive tree, and got the city named after her.

items.name: Hestia
items.hook: The quiet one: no wars, no affairs, just keeping the fire in. Every feast began with an offering to her.
